## Edit playlist: no extra pen button
- The small round pen button in the corner of the cover in "Edit details" is gone on every device
- Changing the photo still works by tapping or clicking the cover, which shows "Choose photo" on hover
- Nothing else changes; the profile picture and other places stay as they were

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
